# Incremental and Full Compile Pipeline

Supports both full repository compiles and incremental (PR or commit-scoped) compiles. Ensures only changed or new units are recompiled and integrates features like PR- and commit-based execution, atomic persistence, and wiki emission.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.compile_full`
